architecture: regularized logistic regression with state values, missing masks, operation one-hot and operation-by-state interactions
coarse_architecture: regularized logistic regression with operation one-hot only on exactly the same eligible native rows
deployment_aggregation: arithmetic mean of all three fixed seeds
optimizer: full-batch gradient descent; no early stopping or checkpoint selection
time_head: ridge regression of log1p measured write/controller seconds; l2=0.02; nonnegative inverse transform
normalization: mean and population standard deviation of observed train features only; scale floor 1; absent values imputed to train mean plus explicit missing mask
labels: only selected action's independently verified native effects; unknown and nonexecuted retain denominator and have no imputed effect label
split_policy: fit train only; report validation calibration without search or recalibration; open test only after model.json is frozen
support_policy: unknown operation, all state features absent, missing core configuration features, newly observed feature never observed for this operation in training, or no known target support returns unknown; optional missing measurements use explicit missing mask and train-mean imputation; no probability fallback or exact-mask matching
core_support_rule: require route; when route exists require replicas; when replicas positive require store route; when store route exists require owner match and store replicas; descendants of known absent paths may be null
scope: laboratory comparison only; regularized point estimates are not production admission bounds
